The number of commodity vessels sailing through the Strait of Hormuz totalled seven on Monday, compared with eight on the previous day, Kpler data showed on Tuesday.Iran had warned that energy infrastructure across the Gulf, including U.S. oil and gas interests, was vulnerable.
